'''Azure sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] and, under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], was part of [[Imperial Center Oversector]]. Planets in the Sector include [[Axum]] and [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector was defended by a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="TEGtW-" />

The [[Garde d'Azure]] was a celebrated [[Planetary Security Forces|Planetary Security Force]] operating in the sector.<ref name="TEGtW-" />
